column1: # 雅思核心词汇 List 05（i 10361–10450）。每行：编号§单词§例句§译文（译文里恰好一处 **…** 标出对应词义）
# 10365、10392 的例句改写过（原句里是 the right / Inner-city，应用在句子里找不到原词形），见 build_ielts.py 的 EDITED。
10361 § penalty § The maximum penalty for the offence is five years. § 该罪行的最高**刑罚**是五年。
10362 § prosecution § The prosecution presented strong evidence. § **控方**出示了有力的证据。
10363 § referendum § The referendum decided the future of the region. § 这次**全民公投**决定了该地区的未来。
10364 § regulation § The new regulation requires companies to disclose data. § 这项新**规章**要求企业披露数据。
10365 § rights § Citizens have basic rights, including the right to a fair trial. § 公民享有基本**权利**，包括接受公正审判的权利。
10366 § rule of law § The rule of law protects citizens from arbitrary power. § **法治**保护公民免受专断权力的侵害。
10367 § sanction § Economic sanctions were imposed on the country. § 该国被施加了经济**制裁**。
10368 § statute § The statute sets out the rules for elections. § 这部**法令**规定了选举的规则。
10369 § testimony § Her testimony was crucial to the case. § 她的**证词**对这起案件至关重要。
10370 § tribunal § The dispute was heard by an employment tribunal. § 这起纠纷由劳动**法庭**审理。
10371 § trial § The trial lasted for three weeks. § 这场**审判**持续了三周。
10372 § verdict § The jury returned a verdict of not guilty. § 陪审团作出了无罪的**裁决**。
10373 § veto § The president used his veto to block the bill. § 总统行使**否决权**阻止了该法案。
10374 § witness § A witness saw the suspect leaving the building. § 一名**目击者**看见嫌疑人离开了大楼。
10375 § offence § Speeding is a minor traffic offence. § 超速是一种轻微的交通**违法行为**。
10376 § suspect § The police arrested a suspect in the robbery. § 警方逮捕了这起抢劫案的一名**嫌疑人**。
10377 § evidence § There was no evidence linking him to the crime. § 没有**证据**表明他与这起犯罪有关。
10378 § innocent § The court declared the defendant innocent. § 法庭宣告被告**无罪**。
10379 § guilty § He was found guilty of fraud. § 他因欺诈被裁定**有罪**。
10380 § deterrent § Heavy fines act as a deterrent to speeding. § 重罚对超速起到**威慑**作用。
10381 § juvenile § Juvenile crime has declined in recent years. § 近年来**青少年**犯罪有所下降。
10382 § accessibility § Good public transport improves accessibility to jobs. § 良好的公共交通提高了就业岗位的**可达性**。
10383 § affordable housing § Affordable housing is a growing problem in big cities. § **经济适用住房**问题在大城市日益突出。
10384 § amenity § The district offers excellent amenities such as parks and shops. § 该区提供公园和商店等一流的**便利设施**。
10385 § commute § Her daily commute takes over an hour. § 她每天的**通勤**要花一个多小时。
10386 § congestion § Traffic congestion is worst during rush hour. § 交通**拥堵**在高峰时段最严重。
10387 § congestion charge § London introduced a congestion charge in its centre. § 伦敦在市中心推行了**拥堵费**。
10388 § downtown § Downtown is crowded with offices and shops. § **市中心**挤满了写字楼和商店。
10389 § emission § Cars produce harmful emissions in cities. § 汽车在城市中产生有害的**排放物**。
10390 § gentrification § Gentrification is pushing up rents in old neighbourhoods. § **绅士化**正在推高老街区的租金。
10391 § infrastructure § The city invested heavily in transport infrastructure. § 这座城市在交通**基础设施**上投入巨大。
10392 § inner city § Schools in the inner city often face the greatest challenges. § **内城区**的学校往往面临最大的挑战。
10393 § metropolis § Tokyo is one of the world's largest metropolises. § 东京是世界上最大的**大都市**之一。
10394 § pedestrian § The street was closed to make it pedestrian-friendly. § 这条街被封闭起来，以便对**行人**更友好。
10395 § pollution § Vehicle exhausts are a major source of air pollution. § 汽车尾气是空气**污染**的主要来源。
10396 § public transport § Using public transport reduces traffic congestion. § 使用**公共交通**可以减少交通拥堵。
10397 § residential § The area is mostly residential, with few shops. § 这个地区以**住宅**区为主，商店很少。
10398 § rural § Rural areas often lack adequate healthcare. § **农村**地区往往缺乏足够的医疗保健。
10399 § skyline § The city skyline is dominated by skyscrapers. § 这座城市的**天际线**以摩天大楼为主。
10400 § sprawl § Urban sprawl is consuming valuable farmland. § 城市**无序扩张**正在吞噬宝贵的农田。
10401 § suburb § Many families moved to the suburbs to find cheaper housing. § 许多家庭搬到**郊区**寻找更便宜的住房。
10402 § sustainable § Cities need sustainable transport systems. § 城市需要**可持续**的交通系统。
10403 § traffic jam § I was stuck in a traffic jam for two hours. § 我被困在**交通堵塞**中两个小时。
10404 § tram § Trams provide reliable transport in the city centre. § **有轨电车**在市中心提供可靠的交通。
10405 § transport network § An efficient transport network links the city to its suburbs. § 高效的**交通网络**把城市与郊区连接起来。
10406 § urban § Urban populations are growing rapidly worldwide. § 全球**城市**人口正在快速增长。
10407 § urbanisation § Rapid urbanisation brings both opportunities and problems. § 快速的**城市化**既带来机遇，也带来问题。
10408 § vehicle § Electric vehicles are becoming more affordable. § 电动**车辆**的价格越来越亲民。
10409 § walkable § The city centre is compact and walkable. § 市中心布局紧凑，**适宜步行**。
10410 § density § High population density puts pressure on housing. § 高人口**密度**给住房带来压力。
10411 § green space § Green spaces improve the quality of urban life. § **绿地**提升了城市生活的质量。
10412 § regeneration § Urban regeneration has transformed the old docklands. § 城市**更新**改变了旧码头区。
10413 § high-rise § High-rise apartments house millions of city residents. § **高层**公寓里住着数百万城市居民。
10414 § land use § Competition for land use is intense in cities. § 城市里**土地利用**的竞争十分激烈。
10415 § megacity § Megacities face huge challenges in housing and transport. § **特大城市**在住房和交通方面面临巨大挑战。
10416 § municipal § The municipal government approved the building plan. § **市政**当局批准了该建设方案。
10417 § outskirts § Factories are located on the outskirts of the city. § 工厂都设在**市郊**。
10418 § overcrowding § Overcrowding in public transport is a daily problem. § 公共交通的**过度拥挤**是每天都有的问题。
10419 § pavement § Cyclists should not ride on the pavement. § 骑行者不应在**人行道**上骑车。
10420 § redevelopment § The redevelopment of the port area created new housing. § 港口区的**再开发**带来了新的住房。
10421 § relocation § The factory's relocation cost many workers their jobs. § 工厂的**搬迁**使许多工人丢了工作。
10422 § road network § The road network struggles to cope with rising traffic. § **道路网络**难以应对不断增长的交通量。
10423 § shanty town § Shanty towns have grown around many large cities. § 许多大城市周围出现并扩大了**贫民窟**。
10424 § traffic congestion § Traffic congestion wastes time and fuel. § **交通拥堵**浪费时间和燃料。
10425 § transportation § Public transportation is heavily subsidised. § 公共**交通**得到大量补贴。
10426 § urban planning § Good urban planning balances housing and green space. § 良好的**城市规划**能平衡住房与绿地。
10427 § commuting § Commuting by bike is healthier than driving. § 骑车**通勤**比开车更健康。
10428 § colonialism § Colonialism left deep marks on many societies. § **殖民主义**在许多社会留下了深深的烙印。
10429 § cultural diversity § Cultural diversity is a source of social vitality. § **文化多样性**是社会活力的源泉。
10430 § diaspora § The Chinese diaspora has settled in every continent. § **华侨华人**已在各大洲定居。
10431 § empire § The Roman Empire once ruled much of Europe. § 罗马**帝国**曾统治欧洲大部分地区。
10432 § ethnocentrism § Ethnocentrism can prevent understanding of other cultures. § **种族中心主义**会妨碍人们理解其他文化。
10433 § folklore § The region has a rich tradition of folklore and song. § 这个地区有丰富的**民间传说**和歌谣传统。
10434 § globalisation § Globalisation has brought cultures closer together. § **全球化**拉近了不同文化之间的距离。
10435 § heritage § Preserving heritage requires long-term investment. § 保护**文化遗产**需要长期投入。
10436 § homogenisation § Critics worry that globalisation leads to cultural homogenisation. § 批评者担心全球化会导致文化**同质化**。
10437 § identity § Globalisation can weaken local cultural identities. § 全球化可能削弱本地的文化**认同**。
10438 § immigration § Immigration has enriched the country's culture. § **移民**丰富了这个国家的文化。
10439 § imperialism § Imperialism reshaped the political map of the world. § **帝国主义**重塑了世界政治版图。
10440 § indigenous § Indigenous languages are disappearing at an alarming rate. § **原住民**语言正以惊人的速度消失。
10441 § integration § Language learning is key to migrant integration. § 语言学习是移民**融入**社会的关键。
10442 § interdependence § Economic interdependence reduces the risk of war. § 经济上的**相互依存**降低了战争风险。
10443 § legacy § The festival is a legacy of the city's trading history. § 这个节日是这座城市贸易历史留下的**遗产**。
10444 § lingua franca § English has become the world's lingua franca. § 英语已成为世界的**通用语**。
10445 § migration § Migration between countries has risen sharply. § 国家之间的**移民**数量急剧上升。
10446 § multicultural § The city has a vibrant multicultural population. § 这座城市拥有充满活力的**多元文化**人口。
10447 § nationalism § Rising nationalism challenges international cooperation. § 不断抬头的**民族主义**挑战着国际合作。
10448 § preservation § The preservation of historic buildings is costly. § 历史建筑的**保护**成本高昂。
10449 § tradition § The ceremony follows a centuries-old tradition. § 这个仪式沿袭着有数百年历史的**传统**。
10450 § transnational § Transnational corporations operate in dozens of countries. § **跨国**公司在几十个国家开展业务。
